record.question:
Fill up the blanks:

(i) Except as provided in regulation 5, the driver of a motor vehicle shall pass to the __________ of all traffic proceeding in the same direction as himself.
(ii) Every driver shall, on the approach of a __________ service vehicle or of an __________. allow it free passage by drawing to the side of the road.
(iii) A driver shall not drive a motor vehicle on road declared __________ except in the direction specified by sign boards.
(iv) No motor vehicle when towing another vehicles other than a trailer or signs car shall be driven at a speed exceeding __________km/hr.
(v) The driver of a motor vehicle shall, when passing or meeting a procession or a body of troops or police on the march or when passing workman engaged on road repair, drive at a speed not exceeding more than __________km/hr.
(vi) Whoever drives a motor vehicle in contravention of section 3 or section 4 shall be punishable with imprisonment for a term which may extend to __________ months or with fine which may extend to Rs __________ or with both.
(vii) No person shall drive or cause or allow to be driven in any public place any motor vehicle with a __________ hand steering control unless it is equipped with a mechanical or electrical signalling device of a prescribed nature and in working order.
(viii) No person under the age of __________ years shall drive a Transport Vehicle in any public place.
